description: This file defines the OrderSetService interface, which declares methods for managing OrderSets and related entities such as OrderSetMembers and attributes within the OpenMRS platform. It includes operations like creating, retrieving, retiring, unretiring, and deleting order sets and associated attribute types.

methods.name: setOrderSetDAO
methods.description: Assigns the data access object responsible for CRUD operations on OrderSet entities.

methods.name: saveOrderSet
methods.description: Saves or updates an OrderSet; may retire associated members if needed.

methods.name: getOrderSets
methods.description: Retrieves a list of OrderSets, optionally including retired ones, filtering out discontinuation OrderSets.

methods.name: getOrderSet
methods.description: Retrieves a specific OrderSet by its internal ID.

methods.name: getOrderSetByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a specific OrderSet by its UUID.

methods.name: retireOrderSet
methods.description: Marks an OrderSet as retired, recording the retire reason.

methods.name: unretireOrderSet
methods.description: Unretires an OrderSet, reversing its retired status.

methods.name: getOrderSetMemberByUuid
methods.description: Fetches an OrderSetMember using its UUID.

methods.name: getOrderSetAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Fetches an OrderSetAttribute using its UUID.

methods.name: getAllOrderSetAttributeTypes
methods.description: Returns all existing OrderSetAttributeType objects, including retired ones.

methods.name: getOrderSetAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderSetAttributeType by internal identifier.

methods.name: getOrderSetAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderSetAttributeType by its UUID.

methods.name: retireOrderSetAttributeType
methods.description: Marks an OrderSetAttributeType as retired, with an optional reason.

methods.name: unretireOrderSetAttributeType
methods.description: Reverses the retired status of an OrderSetAttributeType.

methods.name: purgeOrderSetAttributeType
methods.description: Permanently deletes an OrderSetAttributeType from the system.

methods.name: getOrderSetAttributeTypeByName
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderSetAttributeType by its name.
